whenToUse: Key metrics at the top of a dashboard.
You compare with last week or last month.
One number is enough without a chart.
whenNotToUse: The shape of the trend matters (use a line chart or sparkline).
You can't state the basis of comparison.
There are ten or more metrics and a table would be better.

alternatives.name: Sparkline
alternatives.reason: Adding the trend next to the number.

alternatives.name: Description List
alternatives.reason: Listing several values with their names.

accessibility: The card is a section named after the metric.
Changes are read as words, such as "Up 12% from last week", instead of arrows.
Good and bad are stated in words along with color, not color alone.
